baseline.observedDefect: After finding a course unsuitable, the detail breadcrumb is Home > Explore > course and the category link Golf Course goes to generic /explore/, leaving no contextual return to the 11-course golf comparison.

hypothesis: A golf-specific breadcrumb and clearly named category link to the golf hub will let visitors recover and compare another course without relying on browser Back or global navigation.
boundedChange: Add Golf > /explore/golf/ between Explore and course in the visible breadcrumb for golf details only.
Change the first-screen category link to Compare golf courses > /explore/golf/ for golf details only; leave other experience details unchanged.
metric: All 11 built/live golf details expose both hub routes at 320/390/1440, keyboard navigation reaches the comparison, no overflow or CTA regression; non-golf details retain existing routes.
rollback: Revert the golf-only breadcrumb/category route changes if navigation or layout regresses.
